title: Nana Tere Divey Baldi Main Thak Gayan Mera Akbar Kyun Nahi Aaya
body:
Main Mangiyan Duahwan Tu Kyun Na Pooriyan Kitiyan
Beemar Da Chayta Veeran Nay Bulaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi Tay Aye Mera Raahay Khuda Akbar Nu Paighaam Puchavay
Mar Chaliyan May Raahwan Vekhdi Pardes Tu Jaakay
Koi Khat Vi Na Paaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi Vi Duniya Tay Aye Nana Main Varghi Hamsheer Na Hovay
Barbaad Gharan Vich Rul Gaiyan Na Kol Hai Amri
Na Babay Da Jaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Na Koi Kar Gila Babay Tay Akbar Di Shaadi Kad Hoyi Aye
Pagh Charan To Pehla Kus Gaya Na Mehdniyan Lagiyan
Na Sehra Sajaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Aank Nam Ran Jo Gham Dasvin Day Akhtar Ki Halaat Sunaway
Ainj Chaliyan Zulm Haneirian Ahmad Di Qabar Da
Jinna Deevan Bhujaya
